replacements.replacement_content: Reality may influence self-change rules; open-endedness is not mere ability to change. Closed recursion permits self-modification while reality cannot modify the source of modification, yielding a trajectory that moves through a space. Open recursion lets reality participate in changing future transformation rules, yielding lineage that changes the space through which the system can evolve.

A system is not open merely because it changes; openness requires reality to change how it changes. The deepest source-described transition is change of the transformation-selection mechanism, and the causal target is not merely whether the system adapts.

Normal improvement is capability C increasing. Evolutionary improvement is G_m increasing. Higher-order improvement means improving the machinery that improves mechanisms. Omega is the rate at which a system improves its ability to generate future improvements; it is not capability, growth rate, resources, or current performance, and is described as the internally generated component of reachable-space expansion.
